findings.title: refreshScoreBatch: the asset list uses address types eoa/wallet, but the entries are collateral token contracts.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json refreshScoreBatch field `assets.[]` has params.types ["eoa","wallet"]. ScoreEngineV2.sol refreshScore(address asset) passes asset to colOracle.getScore(collateral), and the interface comment says 'Adresse du token collatéral'. Case 1 lists USDC 0x8335…2913 and cbBTC 0xcbB7…33Bf, and both show as raw hex. The single-asset format correctly uses types ["token"].
findings.fix: Set params.types to ["token"] on `assets.[]`, as in refreshScore, so wallets can show the token names.
